model: EcoSmart Connect control (XBOXER XBC, BPS, BOXER), 2022 object list
applies_to: Nuaire supply and extract ventilation units with heat recovery (XBOXER XBC, BPS and BOXER ranges) fitted with the EcoSmart Connect controller.
summary: The EcoSmart Connect controller is a BACnet MS/TP device (default MAC address 4) built into Nuaire XBC, BPS and BOXER units. Nuaire's object list has 192 numbered objects, all AVs and multistate values in the 28501-28693 range: unit enable, network setpoint and fan speed command, sensor readings from up to eight RM room modules, configuration selections, and alarm MSVs. Two schedules and seven trend logs are listed without instance numbers and are not included here.
notes: The list has no read/write column. Access here is inferred: sensor values, statuses, outputs and alarms are R; enables, setpoints and configuration are W.
Multistate ranges are printed as state texts only (for example Off / On / Hold); they are listed in that order. Enumerated AVs (fan speed request, occupancy) give their numbers.
RM199-RM206 are up to eight room modules on the controller's sensor bus; their objects only carry values when that module is fitted.
Rows printed without an instance (service and notification objects, two schedules, seven trend logs) are left out.
Nuaire's July 2026 manual (672059) renumbers many objects and is a separate entry; some Nuaire quick guides use a 10xxx range. Match the list to the unit's own manual.

source.title: EcoSmart Connect Control Operation Manual, 1.36 BACnet Object List (By Category)

integration.summary: Write MV 28512 Unit Enable to On to run the unit, then set AV 28637 Fan Speed Command (0-100 %) and AV 28669 Network Setpoint. Read the fresh, supply and return air temperatures, MV 28537 Fan Command and the alarm MSVs; MV 28681 resets alarms. Nuaire recommends writing AVs and MSVs at priority 16.
integration.enable: The unit runs when any enable source is active: the Unit Enable MSV (local display or network), volt-free inputs, night cooling, the weekly schedule, a fan speed override or a room module PIR. When the enable is removed the unit runs on for the run-on time.
integration.remote_sensors: MV 28613 Setpoint Operation picks whether the last changed setpoint wins, software only, or last changed with a timeout (AV 28665 Setpoint Timeout). AV 28623 accepts a 0-10 V style fan speed demand from the network.
setup: BACnet MS/TP only; default MS/TP address 4 (AV 28505, range 4-127). Baud rate is MV 28508, Auto by default.
Device instance is assigned at the factory and normally left as is; AV 28506 Device OID holds it.
gotchas: Write AVs and MSVs at priority 16. Do not write outputs; if you must for testing use priority 8 and relinquish afterwards.
Priorities 8 and 16 survive a power cycle; other priority levels are cleared.
The manual's operation text calls the fan and setpoint objects 'Fan Speed Demand' and 'Software Setpoint'; the object list names them Fan Speed Command and Network Setpoint.
